## Decision
- **Approve merge** – you approve this change including the changelog entry and version {x.y.z}. The factory validates exactly that merge result against current `main` (gates again; review and your renewed approval only if the changed `main` may affect it), merges and tags the verified commit.
- **Reject with comment** – a code issue goes back to the build (B3); a requirement issue starts a new spec version (B1).
